desc:
🎬 Welcome to Make a Cartoon! ✏️

✏️ Draw, animate and share your own cartoons!
👍 Like the game and join our group!

🎮 How to Play

➡️ Create a new cartoon
➡️ Add stickmen, animals, props and effects
➡️ Drag their joints to pose them
➡️ Add a new frame and move them a little
➡️ Press Play and watch them move!
➡️ Share your cartoon in the Gallery

✅ That's it, now you know how to play!

✨ Things to look for

✏️ Free drawing with any color and brush size
🎨 Color picker to grab any color from your scene
💬 Speech bubbles to make your characters talk
🎥 Camera moves and zooms
🏙️ Lots of scenes: City, Beach, Space, Night
❤️ Like the best cartoons and reach the Top!
💾 Your cartoons are saved automatically

💻 Supports desktop, mobile and tablet 📱

❤️Like the game, add it to your favorites and spend some time playing!

🛡️ We moderate content to ensure it adheres to Roblox Community Standards. See something off? Use the Report button!
